periods.summary: Ikki's new classmates first crowd around him, then Manabe's group attacks him illegally, after which Shizuku appears and kisses him.
periods.cause: Ikki's duel with Stella has spread online, earning admiration from girls and jealousy from Manabe's group.
periods.process: Kagami asks to interview Ikki. Manabe and four followers draw Devices in class. Ikki uses only body movement, positioning, and a thrown eraser to disable all five without injury.
periods.outcome: The class witnesses Ikki's skill directly. Shizuku enters, praises him, and kisses him in front of everyone.
periods.aftermath: Shizuku's possessive affection shocks Ikki and provokes Stella, leading to a classroom-destroying fight.
casualties: Manabe's group defeated without lasting injury
periods.significance: Shows Ikki's nonmagical combat control, introduces Kagami as reporter, and reunites Ikki with Shizuku after four years.
